title: Here’s how Mass. hospitals fared in the latest U.S. News rankings
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Brigham and Women’s and Massachusetts General Hospitals tied for top in Massachusetts in U.S. News rankings.
Dana-Farber Brigham Cancer Center ranked third nationally for cancer care specialization.
Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Lahey Clinic, and Boston Medical Center ranked third, fourth, and fifth statewide.

title: Stefon Diggs reportedly ‘set to sign’ with Commanders on one-year deal
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Stefon Diggs is reportedly signing a one-year contract with the Washington Commanders, potentially worth up to $12 million.
Diggs caught 85 passes for 1,013 yards with the New England Patriots in 2025, helping them reach the Super Bowl.
The Patriots released Diggs, aged 32, after acquiring A.J. Brown, despite Diggs' recovery from a torn ACL.

title: Patriots teammates believe Will Campbell is ready for Year 2 jump
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Will Campbell is expected to make significant improvements in his second year with the New England Patriots.
Campbell, recovering from a torn MCL, struggled in Super Bowl LX but is showing progress in training camp.
Dre'Mont Jones praises Campbell's development, noting improvements in strength, technique, and consistency.

title: Snag one-way fares for as low as $54 during JetBlue’s fall travel flash sale
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: JetBlue is offering a 48-hour fall travel flash sale with one-way domestic fares starting at $54.
The JetBlue sale applies to Tuesday, Wednesday, and Saturday flights from Sept. 9 to Nov. 18, excluding certain blackout dates.
JetBlue recently announced new fare options and an upcoming launch of BlueFirst, a domestic first-class experience.

title: Moulton doubles down on Epstein-related attacks on Markey
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Rep. Seth Moulton accuses Sen. Ed Markey of connections to Jeffrey Epstein, citing released files during a debate.
The Moulton campaign released images claiming Markey was part of the 'Epstein lobbying effort', despite lacking direct evidence.
Markey denies ties to Epstein, calls Moulton's claims 'unethical', attributing them to campaign distraction tactics.

title: New Red Sox reliever Erik Miller says he learned about trade from TV
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Red Sox acquired reliever Erik Miller from the Giants in exchange for Marcelo Mayer.
Erik Miller first learned about his trade to Boston from a television broadcast.
Miller made his Red Sox debut with a single strikeout on four pitches against the White Sox.

title: ‘Sheer grit and determination’: Mass. 18-year-old with leg injury meets rescuers halfway on Mount Washington
author: John Waller
bullets: An 18-year-old from Massachusetts was injured on Mount Washington, unable to fully bear weight on his leg.
Andrew Nelson, injured a half-mile from the summit, hiked over a quarter-mile back towards the peak for help.
Rescuers assisted Nelson using a vacuum splint and carried him to an ambulance; he chose home treatment.

title: Body washes up at Orient Heights Beach in East Boston
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A female body was found on the shore near Bayswater Street in East Boston on Tuesday afternoon.
Officials discovered the body around 1 p.m., according to the Suffolk County District Attorney's Office.
The investigation into the incident is ongoing, with further updates expected as information becomes available.

title: Charts: See how much Markey and Moulton have raised so far
author: Annie Jonas
bullets: Seth Moulton has raised $5.6 million, outpacing Ed Markey by nearly $1 million in the Senate primary race.
Moulton holds $2.6 million in cash reserves, slightly above Markey’s $2.2 million as of June 30, 2026.
The Massachusetts Democratic primary for the U.S. Senate seat will be held on September 1, 2026.

title: Weston police investigating after masked person spotted outside home overnight
author: John Waller
bullets: Weston police are investigating a masked person caught on surveillance at a home on Highland Street early Sunday.
The individual, wearing a bicycle helmet, did not gain entry but was seen on the property with a flashlight.
Residents are urged to check surveillance footage for any movement during 2:30-3:30 a.m. and contact police at 781-786-6200.
